Casey (Finance): postmortem follow-up — owners & deadlines for token-metering overcount. lanes: eng remediation, billing corrections, comms/support. confirm owners.

Nora (Eng): i'll own eng. suspect delayed event replay + missing idempotency. will produce repro script + ingest-side dedupe. ETA: repro + canary fix 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC.

Harper (Billing): i'll own invoice corrections. need CSV mapping from eng (request_id, customer_id, invoice_id, token_delta). plan: map -> draft credit memos -> run pilot batch (20 invoices) -> full run. target pilot 2026-03-27.

Jules (Support): support will draft templates and queue for enterprise outreach. prefer line-item adjustments for invoices > $800. will prep templates by 2026-03-26 12:00.

Casey (Finance): policy decision: line-item for >$800 or enterprise; account credit otherwise. Nora please paste query for impacted requests.

Nora (Eng): quick query (no PI):

```
SELECT request_id, customer_id, reported_tokens, estimated_tokens, (reported_tokens - estimated_tokens) AS delta
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-24' AND (reported_tokens - estimated_tokens) > 20
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

Nora (Eng): uploading CSV to s3://billing-incidents/2422222222/impacted.csv shortly.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://billing-incidents/2422222222/impacted.csv uploaded by @nora-eng at 2026-03-25T09:05:00Z; rows=334; size=78KB

Nora (Eng): note: adding short-term 10s dedupe window and a 'metering_delta_ratio' grafana panel. will post alert rule link.

Casey (Finance): thanks — i'll update remediation tracker and loop in legal if any refunds requested. update thread on completion. :thumbsup:
